title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Farm (Day)
description:
I did say I'll come back to the stage 1 BG of Sexy Parodius. This BG is seen in the day portion of the level.
Since this BG was long, I decided to rip as best I could. While it was a close to hard territory, I ripped it using Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting feature with near accurate results. You can edit the back area color or you an add the included HDMA effect.

No credit needed.
